metadata.title: ORCHID data
metadata.description:
ORCHID data (Open Repository for CALPHAD Hypotheses, Intelligence, and Discovery), release v2026.10: umbrella record of eight citable datasets, each a separate Zenodo record with its own DOI:

  • ORCHID literature values (doi:10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-literature)
  • ORCHID calculated binary phase diagrams (doi:10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-phase-diagrams)
  • ORCHID binary convex hulls (Materials Project, OQMD, assessed CALPHAD) (doi:10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-hulls)
  • ORCHID DFT-vs-experiment formation-enthalpy benchmark (doi:10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-dft-benchmark)
  • ORCHID phase registry (binary systems) (doi:10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-phase-registry)
  • ORCHID assessed phase assemblages (binary systems) (doi:10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-assessed-phase-assemblages)
  • ORCHID ESPEI datasets from the literature (doi:10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-espei)
  • ORCHID bibliography (doi:10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-bibliography)

Status. Version 1, machine-extracted: values were read from papers by language-model readers constrained to quote their source and checked automatically (quote verification, field-placement rule, printed-page sign checks, DFT and Kim et al. 2017 cross-checks); a hand-checked precision sample is in progress.

This record holds the release documentation: README, CHANGELOG, DATASET_CARD (datasheet with loading examples for pandas, DuckDB and Hugging Face datasets), licences and attributions, the Parquet manifest, and the Zenodo metadata of all nine records. The data files are in the eight dataset records.

Limitations

See each dataset record and DATASET_CARD.md (known limitations). Literature values are machine-extracted (Version 1); calculated and DFT values are model results, not measurements.

Licence

Derived data: CC BY 4.0. Quotes are single sentences under fair use; source papers are not redistributed. Third-party data keep their own licences and citations (NOTICE.md, LICENSES.md in the bundle): SGTE binary collection, Hallstedt 2025 (CC BY 4.0); Materials Project (CC BY 4.0); OQMD (CC BY 4.0).

Files: one zip (orchid-orchid-data-v2026.10.zip) holding the files at their repository paths, a MANIFEST.sha256, the README, CHANGELOG and licence files. Its file list with sizes and SHA-256 is zenodo/orchid-data.files.json in the data repository.

How to cite

R. Arróyave, J. Saal, D. Shin, ORCHID data (version 2026.10; Version 1, machine-extracted), Zenodo (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-orchid-data

Also cite the original source of every value you use (paper_citation / paper_doi, and cited_dois for values the paper cites from earlier work); B. Hallstedt, The SGTE collection of binary datasets, Calphad 89 (2025) 102833, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.calphad.2025.102833 (CC BY 4.0), and the original assessment named in each file; A. Jain et al., The Materials Project: A materials genome approach to accelerating materials innovation, APL Materials 1 (2013) 011002, https://doi.org/10.1063/1.4812323 (CC BY 4.0); J. E. Saal et al., JOM 65 (2013) 1501, https://doi.org/10.1007/s11837-013-0755-4 and S. Kirklin et al., npj Comput. Mater. 1 (2015) 15010, https://doi.org/10.1038/npjcompumats.2015.10 (CC BY 4.0).
